title: Two Smiling Young Girls in Backyard, 1956 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century snapshot capturing two smiling young women or teenage sisters posed together outside on a sunny lawn next to their home. One sits comfortably on a light-colored woven patio chair wearing a blouse, dark skirt, and flats, while the other perches next to her armrest in a jacket. The front border is stamped 'AUG 56' and features deckled edges characteristic of 1950s suburban family photography.
